intro: Placeholder intro. Three jobs, three kinds of machines: dry vacuuming for dust, crumbs and hair; washing for sealed hard floors; and fabric cleaning for stains, pets, carpets and upholstery.

sections.html:
Placeholder text. A vacuum lifts dry debris. A hard-floor washer scrubs sealed floors with water. A carpet or upholstery cleaner sprays, scrubs and extracts stains from fabric.

  • Dust, crumbs, hair: a vacuum
  • Sticky spills on tile, vinyl or sealed wood: a hard-floor washer
  • Pet accidents and stains on carpet or a sofa: a carpet cleaner
